summary.one_liner: Agent Pilot is a desktop workflow automation app for building, chatting with, and scheduling multi-member AI agent workflows with branching chats and a customizable UI.
summary.what_it_does: Lets you create agents and organize them into folders, including multi-member workflows saved as a single agent and nested. Workflows are built as graphs from member types such as User, Agent, Text, Code, Prompt, Module, and Workflow, with vertically aligned members running in parallel. Messages, tools, and code can be edited and re-run to create branching chats. Reusable blocks and tools can be referenced in text fields with curly-brace syntax, and modules (Python files) are imported at runtime. The README also describes a scheduler that accepts natural-language time expressions, structured outputs via Instructor, and LiteLLM-based model provider support.
use_cases: Chat with a single LLM or a multi-step AI workflow
Build and nest multi-agent workflows visually
Run and iterate on AI conversations with branching edits
Schedule recurring AI tasks using plain-English timing
Execute code from chats via an Open Interpreter integration
Connect to many LLM providers through LiteLLM
how_to_run: Download the prebuilt binary for your platform (Linux, Windows, or Mac Intel) from the README's Binaries table
Extract the archive and run the AgentPilot executable
To migrate an old database, replace the old executable with the new one before starting the application
Building from source: follow the 'How to build from source' link in the README (steps not included in the README text)
notable: Graph-based workflow builder where vertically aligned members execute in parallel
Branching chats: edit messages, tools, or code and re-run from that point
Nestable blocks and tools reusable across workflows and text fields via {block-name}
Plugin system for agents, workflows, and model providers, plus custom addons
Customizable hierarchical configuration UI that can be modified while the app runs
caveats: Scheduler is listed as a Premium feature
Voice feature is currently unavailable ('Coming back soon')
CrewAI plugins are currently disabled; some AI generation features are marked 'Coming soon'
Known issues: Windows exe requires a visible console; venv creation on Linux does not install pip; OpenAI Assistant config changes require reopening the chat
